title: Do Nothing, Slowly
setup: Black's king is jammed in the corner on h1 and its only piece with a future is the pawn on g6.
hint: There is no check that works. Ask what Black would have to play if you simply passed.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qg3}} gives no check and takes every square the king had. Black is left with only {{g5}}, and {{Bf3#}} follows. Zugzwang is the move that makes the obligation to move the whole problem.
